messages:
Mira: heads up — us-west2 ephemeral pool spiking. lots of GPUs Pending. scratch drives hitting ~95% iowait, janitor backlog ~12k items :grimacing:
Dan: ugh. same nodes as yesterday? any new errors in scrub logs?
Mira: not the usual firmware errors. this looks like lots of tiny allocation holes after overlayfs GC causing metadata churn -> deep-read retries. i.e. an IO-hole pattern.
Alex: can we short-circuit deep-scrub on preemptible hosts? or move scrub windows off peak GPU schedule?
Mira: plan: 1) reduce janitor concurrency on ephemeral-cleaner from 8 -> 2 for 30m 2) flip deep_scrub=false for preemptible pool 3) route low-priority batch jobs to us-east1 until backlog subsides. rolling now.
infra-bot: config deploy started: janitor/concurrency=2 by Mira — https://ui.redwood/configs/janitor/123 :rocket:
Priya: FYI cost note — moving batches to us-east1 will increase egress + runtime delta, estimate ~+8% for these jobs. happy to accept if it clears capacity faster.
Dan: quick probe — checking backlog metric:
```
curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api/query?m=janitor_backlog&region=us-west2' | jq .value
```
Dan: result: 11980 -> 3200 after the concurrency flip (observed in ~12m). GPUs provisioning queue shrinking.
Mira: good — provisioning pending count down from 420 -> 90. keeping deep-scrub off for another 20m then reevaluate.
sre-oncall: i'll keep watch on provisioning latency and nvme SMARTs. will reopen if provisioning latency >5s or SMART increases. :eyes:
